verdict.rationale: Evidence shows llamafile ships pre-built llamafiles and supports GGUF models (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Phi) and even lets users bundle their own weights into a llamafile, but there is no evidence of a direct Hugging Face download/run integration (e.g., a --hf-repo style flag or documented workflow to pull a model straight from HF and execute it as a llamafile) — users must get a pre-built llamafile or manually build one via the creation process.
